# pennylane_client

> Unofficial, zero-dependency Ruby client for the Pennylane Company API v2. In development, not yet released. Not affiliated with Pennylane.

Planned usage: `require "pennylane_client"`, then `PennylaneClient.new(token: ...)`. Every Pennylane operation reachable through `client.call(:operationId, ...)`, with stable Ruby names such as `client.customer_invoices.finalize(id)`. Ruby >= 3.3, MIT licensed.
